label: D-593913

defects.summary: S5.6.7's answered and cancelled arms check that coai-vh\<8> is empty only when the folder exists, and never assert that the row's home was in coai-vh, so these arms would still pass if the home were reserved somewhere else.

The 'refused before the launch' and 'refused by the launch control' arms never assert that the row's scratch is gone, although S5.6.7's Then asks for this after every ending; only the arms that reach the shim check it, through ThePromptNamesTheCopy.
The Scopes class and the StandIn helper are copied into both new test classes, which makes a third copy of the ones in AKimiConsultationScenarioTests instead of one shared helper.
In S5.5.4, the lambda parameter `said` in the warnings filter shadows the outer `said` JSON local, which makes the assertion hard to read.

The status line names Sonnet as the builder although §0.2 says Opus builds E5.5 and E5.6, and no deviation records this; deviation 55 also cites 'the C3 review's R1', a review that is not in the document and whose name can be confused with Fable's R1.

summary: The diff delivers both stories as the spec says: a Kimi planner arm with no flags (copy for disk, empty folder for none), unconfined none and disk rows that cite M-K6, M-K9 and the other cells, an unmeasured web row, the vectors, the regenerated table, a Build that refuses a plan with any Leading or Flags entry, and all 12 scenarios present and green with no new failures. The findings are all minor: some vacuous existence guards and missing scratch checks in S5.6.7, copied test helpers, and documentation details in the plan's status line and deviation list.
